title: Reason Code 256/289: the client certificate is revoked
plain_english: EAP-TLS: NPS checked the certificate revocation list and the device's certificate is on it. Revocation is deliberate: someone revoked it when the device was retired, the user left, or a new certificate was issued. The device still has the old one and keeps presenting it.

any: proof of their identity is a revoked certificate
certificate provided by the connecting user or computer is revoked

causes.cause: The revoked certificate is still installed on the device and is selected for 802.1X, even if a newer one exists.
causes.next_check: On the device, delete the revoked certificate from the personal store and re-enroll (or restrict certificate selection in the Wi-Fi profile so the new one is used).

causes.cause: The certificate was revoked by mistake, or as part of a CA cleanup.
causes.next_check: On the CA, check the revocation reason for this serial number; if it was an error, revocation cannot be undone: issue a new certificate.
